This file reloads the bootstrap result objects produced by `analyses.Rmd`, and saves each table as its own standalone `.html` file in `tables/`.

----

# Custom functions

```{r setup, results='hide'}

rm(list = ls())

library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)

if (!dir.exists("tables")) dir.create("tables")

# significance stars from the bootstrap t-statistic (original/se), using the
# standard normal critical values -- add to every table's `value` column
sig_stars <- function(t) {
  case_when(
    abs(t) > 3.291 ~ "***",
    abs(t) > 2.576 ~ "**",
    abs(t) > 1.960  ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ ""
  )
}

```

# Table: main analyses (AMEs, M1-M6)

```{r, echo=FALSE}

load("./results/cont_cohort/20260822_ame.rda")
AMEs <- x
rm(x)

```

```{r}

original <- AMEs$t0
bias <- colMeans(AMEs$t) - AMEs$t0
se <- apply(AMEs$t, 2, sd)

df.ames <- data.frame(original = original, bias = bias, se = se)
row.names(df.ames) <- c("AME_gender_m1", "AME_gender_m2", "AME_gender_m3a", "AME_gender_m3b", "AME_gender_m3c", "AME_gender_m4", "AME_cohort_m2", "AME_cohort_m3a", "AME_cohort_m3b", "AME_cohort_m3c", "AME_cohort_m4", "AME_gendercohort_m2", "AME_gendercohort_m3a", "AME_gendercohort_m3b", "AME_gendercohort_m3c", "AME_gendercohort_m4", "AME_time_m1_0", "AME_time_m1_1", "AME_time_m1_2", "AME_time_m1_3", "AME_time_m1_4", "AME_time_m1_5", "AME_time_m1_6", "AME_time_m1_7", "AME_time_m1_8", "AME_time_m2_0", "AME_time_m2_1", "AME_time_m2_2", "AME_time_m2_3", "AME_time_m2_4", "AME_time_m2_5", "AME_time_m2_6", "AME_time_m2_7", "AME_time_m2_8", "AME_time_m3a_0", "AME_time_m3a_1", "AME_time_m3a_2", "AME_time_m3a_3", "AME_time_m3a_4", "AME_time_m3a_5", "AME_time_m3a_6", "AME_time_m3a_7", "AME_time_m3a_8", "AME_time_m3b_0", "AME_time_m3b_1", "AME_time_m3b_2", "AME_time_m3b_3", "AME_time_m3b_4", "AME_time_m3b_5", "AME_time_m3b_6", "AME_time_m3b_7", "AME_time_m3b_8", "AME_time_m3c_0", "AME_time_m3c_1", "AME_time_m3c_2", "AME_time_m3c_3", "AME_time_m3c_4", "AME_time_m3c_5", "AME_time_m3c_6", "AME_time_m3c_7", "AME_time_m3c_8", "AME_time_m4_0", "AME_time_m4_1", "AME_time_m4_2", "AME_time_m4_3", "AME_time_m4_4", "AME_time_m4_5", "AME_time_m4_6", "AME_time_m4_7", "AME_time_m4_8",  "AME_cpubs_m3a", "AME_cpubs_m3b", "AME_cpubs_m3c", "AME_cpubs_m4", "AME_ppubs_m3a", "AME_ppubs_m3b", "AME_ppubs_m3c", "AME_ppubs_m4", "AME_netsize_m3b", "AME_netsize_m3c", "AME_netsize_m4", "AME_prof_m3b", "AME_prof_m3c", "AME_prof_m4", "AME_svpubs_m3b", "AME_svpubs_m3c", "AME_svpubs_m4", "AME_womsv_m3c", "AME_womsv_m4", "AME_genderwomsv_m4")

df.ames$t <- (df.ames$original / df.ames$se)

# remove the time=0 rows, as 0 is the reference category for time
rows_to_remove <- grep("^AME_time_m(1|2|3a|3b|3c|4)_0$", rownames(df.ames))
df.ames <- df.ames[-rows_to_remove, ]

```

```{r}

# neat labels (identical to analyses.Rmd's "Table 'Results main analyses'")
table_ames <- df.ames %>%
  mutate(term = rownames(df.ames),
         var = str_extract(term, "(?<=AME_)[^_]+"),
         model = str_extract(term, "m[1-4][abc]?")) %>%
  mutate(model = recode(model,
                        "m1" = "M1",
                        "m2" = "M2",
                        "m3a" = "M3",
                        "m3b" = "M4",
                        "m3c" = "M5",
                        "m4" = "M6"),
         model = factor(model, levels = paste0("M", 1:6))) %>%
  mutate(label = case_when(
    str_detect(term, "gendercohort") ~ "PhD cohort * Woman",
    str_detect(term, "genderwomsv") ~ "Women supervisors * Woman",
    str_detect(term, "gender") ~ "Woman",
    str_detect(term, "time") ~ paste0("Time since PhD: ", str_extract(term, "[:digit:]$"), " years"),
    str_detect(term, "cohort") ~ "PhD cohort",
    str_detect(term, "womsv") ~ "Women supervisors",
    str_detect(term, "cpubs") ~ "Cumulative publications",
    str_detect(term, "ppubs") ~ "Previous publications",
    str_detect(term, "netsize") ~ "Team size",
    str_detect(term, "prof") ~ "2+ professors",
    str_detect(term, "svpubs") ~ "Supervisors' productivity",
    TRUE ~ str_to_title(var)
  )) %>%
  mutate(value = sprintf("%.4f (%.4f)%s", original, se, sig_stars(t))) %>%
  select(label, model, value)

rows_tab <- c("Woman", "Time since PhD: 1 years", "Time since PhD: 2 years", "Time since PhD: 3 years", "Time since PhD: 4 years", "Time since PhD: 5 years", "Time since PhD: 6 years", "Time since PhD: 7 years", "Time since PhD: 8 years", "PhD cohort", "PhD cohort * Woman", "Cumulative publications", "Previous publications", "Team size", "2+ professors", "Supervisors' productivity", "Women supervisors", "Women supervisors * Woman")

table_df <- table_ames %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = value) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = rows_tab)) %>%
  arrange(label)

n_coef_rows <- nrow(table_df)

# Controls row: field and university enter the model formula from M3 onward
# but never get their own AME computed (no counterfactual dataset pair was
# built for them), so they'd otherwise be silently missing from the table
controls_row <- tibble::tribble(
  ~label,       ~M1,            ~M2,            ~M3,        ~M4,        ~M5,        ~M6,
  "Field",      "Not included", "Not included", "Included", "Included", "Included", "Included",
  "University", "Not included", "Not included", "Included", "Included", "Included", "Included"
)

table_df <- bind_rows(table_df, controls_row)

table_df[is.na(table_df)] <- ""

table_main <- kable(table_df, "html", escape = FALSE, align = "lcccccc",
      col.names = c("", paste0("M", 1:6))) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Average Marginal Effects (AMEs) on Veni Receipt" = 6)) %>%
  pack_rows("Controls", n_coef_rows + 1, n_coef_rows + 2) %>%
  footnote(general = "* p < .05, ** p < .01, *** p < .001 (based on the bootstrap t-statistic)",
           general_title = "")

table_main

save_kable(table_main, file = "tables/table_ame_main.html")

```

# Table: mediation analysis

```{r, echo=FALSE}

load("./results/20260822mediations.rda")
mediations <- x
rm(x)

```

```{r}

original <- mediations$t0
bias <- colMeans(mediations$t) - mediations$t0
se <- apply(mediations$t, 2, sd)

df.med <- data.frame(original = original, bias = bias, se = se)
row.names(df.med) <- c("AME_gender_m1", "AME_gender_m2", "AME_gender_m3", "AME_gender_m4_size", "AME_gender_m4_prof", "AME_gender_m4_pubs", "AME_gender_m4", "AME_gender_m5", "AME_gender_m6", "AME_gender_d12", "AME_gender_d23", "AME_gender_d4size", "AME_gender_d4prof", "AME_gender_d4pubs", "AME_gender_d34", "AME_gender_d45", "AME_gender_d56")
df.med$t <- (df.med$original / df.med$se)

table_med <- df.med %>%
  mutate(term = rownames(df.med),
         value = sprintf("%.4f (%.4f)%s", original, se, sig_stars(t))) %>%
  select(term, value)

table_med_kable <- kable(table_med, "html", escape = FALSE, align = "lc", row.names = FALSE,
      col.names = c("Term", "AME (SE)")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Mediation analysis: gender gap in Veni receipt" = 1)) %>%
  footnote(general = "* p < .05, ** p < .01, *** p < .001 (based on the bootstrap t-statistic)",
           general_title = "")

save_kable(table_med_kable, file = "tables/table_mediations.html")

```

```{r}

# each cohort's model has a different set of terms (not just a different N),
# so each needs its own row-name vector -- these are copied verbatim from
# the row.names(df.cohX) <- ... assignments in analyses.Rmd, not derived
# generically:
# - cohort 1: "base" set, time = 0-8 for every model
# - cohort 2: same as cohort 1, PLUS AME_2015_mX / AME_gender2015_mX (a
#   post-2015 check specific to this cohort)
# - cohort 3: "base" set, but time only goes 0-5 (fewer years observed)

rows_tab_coh <- c("Woman", "Time since PhD: 1 years", "Time since PhD: 2 years", "Time since PhD: 3 years", "Time since PhD: 4 years", "Time since PhD: 5 years", "Time since PhD: 6 years", "Time since PhD: 7 years", "Time since PhD: 8 years", "Post-2015", "Post-2015 * Woman", "Cumulative publications", "Previous publications", "Team size", "2+ professors", "Supervisors' productivity", "Women supervisors", "Women supervisors * Woman")

make_coh_table <- function(cohort_obj, row_names, cohort_label) {

  original <- cohort_obj$t0
  se <- apply(cohort_obj$t, 2, sd)

  df.coh <- data.frame(original = original, se = se)
  df.coh$t <- df.coh$original / df.coh$se
  row.names(df.coh) <- row_names

  rows_to_remove <- grep("^AME_time_m(1|2|3a|3b|3c|4)_0$", rownames(df.coh))
  df.coh <- df.coh[-rows_to_remove, ]

  table_ames_coh <- df.coh %>%
    mutate(term = rownames(df.coh),
           var = str_extract(term, "(?<=AME_)[^_]+"),
           model = str_extract(term, "m[1-4][abc]?")) %>%
    mutate(model = recode(model,
                          "m1" = "M1", "m2" = "M2", "m3a" = "M3",
                          "m3b" = "M4", "m3c" = "M5", "m4" = "M6"),
           model = factor(model, levels = paste0("M", 1:6))) %>%
    mutate(label = case_when(
      str_detect(term, "genderwomsv") ~ "Women supervisors * Woman",
      # must come before the generic "gender" check: cohort 2 has extra
      # AME_2015_mX / AME_gender2015_mX terms that "gender" would otherwise
      # also match, colliding with the real AME_gender_mX row (pivot_wider
      # can't collapse two different values into the same label+model cell)
      str_detect(term, "gender2015") ~ "Post-2015 * Woman",
      str_detect(term, "^AME_2015") ~ "Post-2015",
      str_detect(term, "gender") ~ "Woman",
      str_detect(term, "time") ~ paste0("Time since PhD: ", str_extract(term, "[:digit:]$"), " years"),
      str_detect(term, "womsv") ~ "Women supervisors",
      str_detect(term, "cpubs") ~ "Cumulative publications",
      str_detect(term, "ppubs") ~ "Previous publications",
      str_detect(term, "netsize") ~ "Team size",
      str_detect(term, "prof") ~ "2+ professors",
      str_detect(term, "svpubs") ~ "Supervisors' productivity",
      TRUE ~ str_to_title(var)
    )) %>%
    mutate(value = sprintf("%.4f (%.4f)%s", original, se, sig_stars(t))) %>%
    select(label, model, value)

  table_df_coh <- table_ames_coh %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = value) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    mutate(label = factor(label, levels = rows_tab_coh)) %>%
    arrange(label)

  n_coef_rows_coh <- nrow(table_df_coh)

  # same Controls row as the main table (field/uni enter from M3 onward)
  controls_row <- tibble::tribble(
    ~label,       ~M1,            ~M2,            ~M3,        ~M4,        ~M5,        ~M6,
    "Field",      "Not included", "Not included", "Included", "Included", "Included", "Included",
    "University", "Not included", "Not included", "Included", "Included", "Included", "Included"
  )

  table_df_coh <- bind_rows(table_df_coh, controls_row)

  table_df_coh[is.na(table_df_coh)] <- ""

  header_label <- setNames(6, paste0("Average Marginal Effects (AMEs) on Veni Receipt (", cohort_label, ")"))

  kable(table_df_coh, "html", escape = FALSE, align = "lcccccc",
        col.names = c("", paste0("M", 1:6))) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
    column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>%
    add_header_above(c(" " = 1, header_label)) %>%
    pack_rows("Controls", n_coef_rows_coh + 1, n_coef_rows_coh + 2) %>%
    footnote(general = "* p < .05, ** p < .01, *** p < .001 (based on the bootstrap t-statistic)",
             general_title = "")
}

table_coh1 <- make_coh_table(cohort1, coh1_rownames, "Cohort 1: 1997-2006")
table_coh2 <- make_coh_table(cohort2, coh2_rownames, "Cohort 2: 2007-2014")
table_coh3 <- make_coh_table(cohort3, coh3_rownames, "Cohort 3: 2015-2019")

table_coh1
table_coh2
table_coh3

save_kable(table_coh1, file = "tables/table_cohort1.html")
save_kable(table_coh2, file = "tables/table_cohort2.html")
save_kable(table_coh3, file = "tables/table_cohort3.html")

```
